@@U01033@@
You haven't heard the half of it yet. There’s more. I know it backwards and forwards, it’s all like that. Ah, the time it’s cost me! A waste! A perfect contradiction, you see, the totally nonsensical is as deep a mystery to wise men as to fools. It’s a game, my friend, a game they've made an art, as old as it is new. Its purpose is always to spread lies instead of truth, all by proclaiming the Three-in-One and One-in-Three. It’s a safe choice. You can chatter and teach in the same breath, and no one to bother you. Who wants to waste his time on fools? Besides, people hear words, and what's their first thought? That behind every word there must be sense.

@@U01035@@
(Continuing.)

@@U01036@@
The lofty light Of science’s might From all the world is hidden! Refuse to think, It comes in a wink, It flies on wings unbidden!

@@U01038@@
What’s this drivel she’s babbling at us? My head’s about to split. It’s like hearing a hundred thousand fools in chorus.

@@U01040@@
Enough, enough, excellent sibyl! Bring on your potion and be sure to fill the cup full.
translation:
@@U01033@@
你还没听完一半。还有更多。我前后都知道，都是这样。啊，这花费了我的时间！浪费！你看，这是一个完美的矛盾，完全荒谬的事情对于智者和傻瓜来说都是一个深奥的谜。这是一款游戏，我的朋友，一款被他们打造为艺术的游戏，既古老又新颖。它的目的始终是传播谎言而不是真理，所有这些都是通过宣扬三合一和三合一来实现的。这是一个安全的选择。你可以边聊天边教学，没有人打扰你。谁愿意把时间浪费在傻瓜身上呢？此外，人们听到话语，他们的第一想法是什么？每句话背后都必须有道理。

@@U01035@@
（继续。）

@@U01036@@
科学力量的崇高光芒从全世界都隐藏起来了！拒绝思考，它来得一眨眼，它不请自来地展翅飞翔！

@@U01038@@
她对我们胡言乱语是什么？我的头快要裂开了。这就像听到十万个傻瓜齐声合唱。

@@U01040@@
够了，够了，优秀的女预言家！带上你的药水，并确保将杯子装满。
